watch_keywords: East Nusa Tenggara earthquake deaths BNPB
key_facts: Aug 14 BREAKING UPDATE (T+1d; Exa Watchers/CGTN/7NEWS/La Stampa/Primicias Aug 14 + local Straits Times Aug 14; MAJOR FLIP Central Sulawesi 0.97->0.19, East Nusa Tenggara 0.00->0.78): At 21:58 UTC Aug 14 (05:58 WITA Saturday Aug 15 local time), a massive shallow M7.7 earthquake struck 68 km NNW of Ende right off the north coast of Flores Island, East Nusa Tenggara (USGS 10 km depth, BMKG 14-15 km, EMSC 35 km), followed by M5.9, M5.6, and M6.1 aftershocks within 30 minutes. USGS issued a YELLOW PAGER alert for shaking fatalities (56,000 in severe shaking MMI VIII, 420,000 in very strong MMI VII, 1.17M strong MMI VI in vulnerable unreinforced brick structures) and noted tsunami/landslide secondary hazards; BMKG issued a Level 2 (Siaga) tsunami warning across 22 coastal districts in East Nusa Tenggara, West Nusa Tenggara, South Sulawesi, and Southeast Sulawesi (arrival times starting 4 min after quake). Because Central Sulawesi only leads with 3 BNPB fatalities (June 16 M6.7 Palu/Sigi quake), East Nusa Tenggara only needs >=4 BNPB-reported fatalities by Aug 17 (~66 hours of reporting time). Historical reference class (10/10 shallow Indonesian M7.5-7.9 quakes within 100 km of populated islands killed >=4, including 1992 Flores M7.8), 05:58 AM in-bed timing, and tsunami/landslide risk vs EMSC 35 km depth uncertainty and zero confirmed counts yet (only 2h post-quake at sim cutoff) yield calibrated East Nusa Tenggara 0.78, Central Sulawesi 0.19, South Sulawesi 0.012, West Nusa Tenggara 0.008, West Java 0.004 (sum 0.994).
next_review_trigger: IMMEDIATE Aug 15 CHECK: Check BNPB official fatality count for Aug 14/15 M7.7 Flores (East Nusa Tenggara) earthquake; if >=4 confirmed fatalities, raise East Nusa Tenggara to 0.97-0.985; if confirmed 0-2 fatalities with tsunami warning cancelled and minimal damage, revert toward Central Sulawesi.
